whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm vcpkg-configuration.json no longer carries an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
